reasoning_content: Let me get the internal supabase URL from the docker network and the postgres password:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Find POSTGRES_PASSWORD
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -r 'POSTGRES' /opt/areloria/ /opt/supabase* 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'password' | head -3")
print("Pass found:", stdout.read().decode())

# Get container's internal hostname by pinging from engine network
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep 'internalUrl\\|postgres' /opt/areloria/docker-compose.prod.yml 2>&1 | head -10")
print("Compose:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
